name: ajaia-doc-editor
description: Ajaia Docs - a lightweight collaborative document editor (AI-Native Full Stack Developer assignment)

scripts.dev: npm run -s build && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file=./migrations/0001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file=./migrations/0002_profile.sql && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file=./migrations/0003_versions_sharing.sql
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 execute ajaia-docs --remote -y --file=./migrations/0001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute ajaia-docs --remote -y --file=./migrations/0002_profile.sql && wrangler d1 execute ajaia-docs --remote -y --file=./migrations/0003_versions_sharing.sql
